title: Holiday Bonus Gift Card Promotion Parameters (Gift Cards & Store Credit)
content:
The holiday bonus promotion is the issue channel of the Bonus Gift Card and of no other Gift Cards & Store Credit type. Its parameters are set on the Bonus Gift Card alone; every other type carries zero or not-applicable values.

| Instrument type | Gift-card purchase value on one order that earns one bonus block (USD) | Bonus value issued per block (USD) | First order date of the promotion | Last order date of the promotion | Bonus voided or clawed back when the qualifying gift-card purchase is cancelled or refunded |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bonus Gift Card | 100.00 | 20.00 | 27 November 2026 (2026-11-27) | 24 December 2026 (2026-12-24) | Yes |
| Marlowe Rewards Note | 0.00 | 0.00 | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |
| Goodwill Credit | 0.00 | 0.00 | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |
| Return Store Credit | 0.00 | 0.00 | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | 0.00 | 0.00 | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | 0.00 | 0.00 | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |

## Block arithmetic (hypothetical orders)

A bonus block is one whole 100.00 of gift-card purchase value on a single order; a part block does not count.

| Hypothetical gift-card lines on one order | Whole blocks of 100.00 |
|---|---|
| 99.99 | 0 |
| 100.00 | 1 |
| 250.00 | 2 |
